scope: The actual complete raw-height scalar divergence operator, holonomy flux, true-angle positive-band weak Dirichlet/source Green and both-end relative DN in an explicit full-frequency radial energy trace space.

inputs.true_trace_space: sum over every m in 4Z of f_m^* S_m f_m, plus the independent common mean height

checks.name: exact_raw_height_t_coefficient
checks.evidence: mu=(w/a) J D^-3/2 includes all actual first-order terms

checks.name: exact_raw_height_theta_coefficient
checks.evidence: The independent U_theta,V_theta terms cancel in the full divergence identity

checks.name: exact_raw_height_principal
checks.evidence: The complete principal matrix is retained

checks.name: exact_full_holonomy_K_Euler_derivative
checks.evidence: G_K=w^2 rho J, including the mean

checks.name: exact_full_holonomy_P_Euler_derivative
checks.evidence: G_P-d_theta G_U=-w^2 rho E(V-P)

checks.name: exact_ordinary_scalar_density_source
checks.evidence: The true source is w^2 J rho e, not an endpoint jump

checks.name: exact_raw_conormal_holonomy_identity
checks.evidence: <p_raw>=delta M after the complete angular Euler integration

checks.name: actual_D_series_domain
checks.evidence: All coefficient ratios use the actual small relative state

checks.name: actual_inverse_root_derivative_bound
checks.evidence: The inverse square-root first derivative is below 1

checks.name: actual_complete_positive_form_relative_fee
checks.evidence: Includes the actual angle Jacobian at both endpoints

checks.name: actual_positive_form_coercivity
checks.evidence: The same energy completion works at true A=0 endpoints

checks.name: exact_complete_two_end_DN_matrix
checks.evidence: Both outward fluxes and the exact nonzero cross term are retained

checks.name: exact_independent_mean_translation_kernel
checks.evidence: Mean height difference and flux remain; only the common height is a kernel

checks.name: exact_mean_difference_energy
checks.evidence: The complete mean energy uses the true radial resistance

checks.name: ordinary_source_green_relative_fee
checks.evidence: The resolvent identity retains the actual ordinary source functional

checks.name: ordinary_source_flux_full_dual_fee
checks.evidence: The complete two-end source flux, including its translation test row, is below 2 S_I

checks.name: actual_nonzero_angular_Poincare_constant
checks.evidence: All real fourfold modes are included; there is no discarded low nonzero mode

checks.name: whole_source_contract_keeps_translation
checks.evidence: C_I=1+2 sqrt(R_I)+1/(4 sqrt(M_I)) bounds full height, not just its angular derivative

checks.name: source_outward_flux_mean_kept
checks.evidence: Testing the exact divergence identity against 1 gives total outward flux=int source
